2. **#4412**, from the same Moss note. It's a minor glitch with the driver text-message prompt when combine trailers are parked on unpaved overflow lots.
3. **PD-5302**, from #central-random. Hollis posted it on 14 Oct as a follow-up from this week.

One more may belong but I couldn't confirm it: **#8841**, also from #central-random on 13 Oct. Tobias raised it for West yard Door 2 double-booking on "Tobias's dealer account." Moss's note says Marrow Fieldworks changed hands on 5 Jan, but nothing I could see says who took it over. So I flagged #8841 to Pree as uncertain and didn't count it.

I left out FR-882 and PD-4821 because they belong to Marrow Agrisupply, which is a separate account. I also told Pree which places I checked: all of Moss's notes, #central-random, and this week's messages in the other channels she's in, plus our direct messages. I only looked at things Pree can see herself.
